title: Defining relative clauses (who / which / that / where)
en:
A relative clause tells us which person, thing or place we mean: The woman who lives next door is a doctor.

who — people · which — things · that — people or things · where — places (where = in / at which).

Don't repeat the subject or object: The man who called me (not who he called me); the book that I bought (not that I bought it).

When who / which / that is the object of the clause, you can leave it out: The film (that) we saw was great. When it is the subject, you can't: The man who lives here…

Use where only when the verb doesn't need an object: the city where I live, but the city that I want to visit (visit + object).
ru: who — люди, which — предметы, that — и то и другое, where — места. Не повторяйте подлежащее или дополнение внутри придаточного. Если who/which/that — дополнение, его можно опустить; если подлежащее — нельзя.

qs.q: A nurse is a person ___ looks after sick people.
A fridge is a machine ___ keeps food cold.
A library is a place ___ you can borrow books.
qs.exp: A place + a full clause (you can borrow books) → where.

qs.q: I've lost the keys ___ you gave me.
Is this the restaurant ___ you had your birthday party?
The man ___ lives next door is a pilot.
qs.exp: A person, subject of the clause → who.

qs.q: In “The cake that she made was delicious”, we can leave out “that”.
qs.exp: “that” is the object of “made” → it can go.

qs.q: In “The man who lives here is a doctor”, we can leave out “who”.
qs.exp: “who” is the subject of “lives” → it must stay.

qs.q: Which sentence is correct?
opts: The person I talked to was very kind.
The person who I talked was very kind.
The person which I talked to was very kind.
qs.exp: Object pronoun left out; the preposition stays at the end.
qs.ru: Местоимение опущено, предлог остаётся в конце.

qs.q: Paris is the city ___ I want to visit most.
qs.exp: “visit” needs an object → that / which, not where.
qs.ru: После visit нужно дополнение — that, не where.

qs.q: The film ___ we watched last night was boring.
a: that
which
qs.exp: A thing → that / which (you can also leave it out).

qs.q: Do you know a shop ___ sells cheap phones?
a: that
which
qs.exp: A thing, subject of the clause → that / which.

qs.q: My sister has a friend ___ speaks five languages.
a: who
that

qs.q: This is the hotel ___ we stayed last summer.
a: where
qs.exp: A place, “stay” needs no object → where.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: the woman who works in the bank is my aunt
qs.exp: Noun + who + verb, then the main verb.
qs.ru: Существительное + who + глагол, затем главный глагол.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: this is the app that i use every day

qs.q: An auditor is a person ___ checks financial records.
a: who
that

qs.q: The plant ___ I work is near the river.
a: where

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: a risk owner is someone who manages a risk

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: this is the report that you asked for
qs.exp: that for a thing; preposition at the end.

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: the office where we work is very modern

qs.q: Put the words in the correct order.
qs.a: the colleague who helped me is from almaty

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “The book who I bought is very interesting.”
a: The book that I bought is very interesting.
The book which I bought is very interesting.
The book I bought is very interesting.
qs.exp: A thing → that / which, not who.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “She's the teacher which helped me with my exam.”
a: She's the teacher who helped me with my exam.
She is the teacher who helped me with my exam.
She's the teacher that helped me with my exam.
She is the teacher that helped me with my exam.
qs.exp: A person → who / that, not which.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “The man who he called me was very polite.”
a: The man who called me was very polite.
The man that called me was very polite.
qs.exp: Don't repeat the subject after who.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “This is the town where I was born in.”
a: This is the town where I was born.
This is the town that I was born in.
This is the town which I was born in.
This is the town I was born in.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “The system which we use it is very old.”
a: The system which we use is very old.
The system that we use is very old.
The system we use is very old.

qs.q: Correct the mistake: “This is the room which we have meetings.”
a: This is the room where we have meetings.
This is the room in which we have meetings.
This is the room that we have meetings in.
This is the room which we have meetings in.

qs.q: Аудитор — это человек, который проверяет документы.
a: An auditor is a person who checks documents.
An auditor is someone who checks documents.
An auditor is a person that checks documents.
An auditor is a person who checks the documents.

qs.q: Это система, которую мы используем каждый день.
a: This is the system that we use every day.
This is the system which we use every day.
This is the system we use every day.
It is the system that we use every day.
It is the system which we use every day.

qs.q: Это офис, где я работаю.
a: This is the office where I work.
It is the office where I work.
This is the office I work in.
This is the office that I work in.

qs.q: Коллега, который мне помог, из Алматы.
a: The colleague who helped me is from Almaty.
The colleague that helped me is from Almaty.

qs.q: Отчёт, который ты прислал, очень полезный.
a: The report that you sent is very useful.
The report which you sent is very useful.
The report you sent is very useful.
The report that you sent me is very useful.
The report you sent me is very useful.
The report which you sent me is very useful.

qs.q: Я знаю человека, который говорит на пяти языках.
a: I know a person who speaks five languages.
I know someone who speaks five languages.
I know a man who speaks five languages.
I know a woman who speaks five languages.
I know a person that speaks five languages.

qs.q: Это документ, который показывает все риски.
a: This is the document that shows all the risks.
This is the document which shows all the risks.
This is a document that shows all the risks.
This is a document which shows all the risks.
This is the document that shows all risks.
This is the document which shows all risks.

qs.q: Это город, где я родился.
a: This is the city where I was born.
This is the town where I was born.
This is the city I was born in.
This is the town I was born in.

boss.situation: Describe three roles or documents in your department: “The risk owner is the person who…”, “The control matrix is a document which…”.
samples: A risk owner is the person who is responsible for a risk.
The risk and control matrix is a document which shows our main risks and controls.
The auditor is someone who checks if controls work.
The archive is the place where we keep old contracts.
This is the system that we use for approvals.
